idee_recherchee.texte: The holographic principle proposes that all the information contained in a volume of space can be encoded on its boundary surface, as if our three-dimensional universe were a projection from a two-dimensional surface.

titre_video: Scientists Are Freaking Out Over Space Time (It's Not Real)
titre: Le dilemme terrifiant : libre arbitre ou espace-temps
resume: The cosmic Bell test forces a dilemma: accept superdeterminism, where space and time may be real but free will is fake, or reject it and accept that space and time are a holographic projection of quantum data. Either way one fundamental belief about the world, life or choices is wrong.
texte: Even if you want to reject these ideas, the alternative is not any more comforting. The cosmic bell test has plunged humanity into a terrifying dilemma. On the one hand, you can believe in superdeterminism, and that means that space and time as we know them might be real, but free will is fake and nothing you do is ever really your decision. On the other hand, you can reject superdeterminism, but then you have to accept that space and time are simply illusions. The world around you is basically a holographic movie projection of quantum data. Either way, you have to accept that at least one of those fundamental things you thought about the world, about your life, and about your own choices and experiences is wrong, and that is the most frightening part of all.
